title: 2017 AMC 10A Problem 3
statement: Tamara has three rows of two \(6\)-feet by \(2\)-feet flower beds in her garden. The beds are separated and also surrounded by \(1\)-foot-wide walkways, as shown on the diagram. What is the total area of the walkways, in square feet?

solutions.text:
We can see that the width of the garden is \[2 \cdot 6 + 3 \cdot 1 = 15.\] We can also see that the height is \[ 3 \cdot 2 + 4 \cdot 1 = 10. \] The total area of the garden is therefore \(15 \cdot 10 = 150.\) The area of all the flower beds is \[ 6 \cdot 2 \cdot 6 = 72. \] Subtracting this from the area of the garden yields \(150 - 72 = 78,\) which is the area of the walkways.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Find the dimensions of the whole rectangular garden including walkways
Subtract the total area of the six flower beds from the outside rectangle
